Corollary
[Evolution of the area form] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0122 1. Corollary 5.5\group evolution-equations-on-surfaces

If $g(t)$ is a smooth $1$-parameter family of metrics on $\mathcal{M}^n$ such that \[ \frac{\partial }{\partial t}g = h, \] then the volume form evolves by \[ \frac{\partial }{\partial t}d\mu = \frac12 \operatorname {tr}_g(h)\, d\mu . \]
